changelog:
- Added a contrast-checking script: scripts/check-contrast.mjs.
- Enables automated validation of color contrast ratios for design tokens and palettes.
- Script can be run via Node to ensure color pairs meet WCAG 2.2 AA standards.
- Supports both single pair and JSON-configured palette checks for seamless integration into build/CI pipelines.
summary: Apply WCAG 2 Level AA accessibility standards to design systems, UI components, and web pages — contrast math with a runnable validator, design-token patterns that make color accessible by construction, typography and focus-state rules, and a semantics checklist.
